title: MindMesh - The Cognitive Layer for modern work
excerpt: Purpose-built for the modern professional. Connect your apps, see what needs attention, act with approval.
content_html:
The Cognitive
Layer for
modern work

MindMesh connects your apps, ranks what needs your attention right now, and helps you act with approval.

In modern work, attention is the most important resource, and context switching is expensive.

Built for the teams who ship first: PMs, engineers, and product builders.

A new species of AI assistant. MindMesh sits above your stack and answers one question: what should I do right now? Restore calm and attention with MindMesh.

FIG 0.5

Every connected source keeps feeding one growing memory, quietly and in order.

Three steps from noise to action.

01

Connect your apps

Connect Gmail, Slack, Jira, calendars, and more. MindMesh reads them as sources without replacing your tools.

02

See what needs attention

A ranked Attention Board shows what is Now, Later Today, and Quietly Handled, with clear why-now reasons.

03

Act with approval

Prepare the reply, block the time, and stage the task update. You approve before anything sends or writes.

Features

Go deeper on what MindMesh does.

Depth pages for the layers behind connect, prioritize, and execute.

Built on trust you can verify. AI orchestration for people who will not trade control of their data for convenience.

Private by design: local-first architecture, encrypted connections, and read-only integrations where it matters.
